serp_features.title: AI Overview
serp_features.text:
AI Mode reply for Randstad Singapore employee reviews
Employee reviews for Randstad Singapore generally reflect a mixed-to-average work experience, leaning heavily on whether you are working as an internal recruitment/staffing consultant or as a placed contractor.www.glassdoor.sg+1Overall Ratings
Glassdoor (Singapore): ~3.0 / 5 stars (based on 65+ reviews), which sits below the regional industry average of 3.8 stars.
Recommendation to a friend: ~46%
CEO approval: ~7%www.glassdoor.sg
Other Platforms (Indeed / Jobstore / Jobstreet): Generally range higher between 3.7 to 4.0 / 5 stars, praised more frequently for team camaraderie, learning curves, and administrative support.Indeed+2
Key Pros (What Employees Like)
Supportive & Friendly Teams: Colleagues and immediate managers are often described as helpful, approachable, and collaborative.Jobstore+1
Brand Name & Market Exposure: Working at a major global HR and staffing agency provides great insight into the local Singaporean job market and builds a strong professional network.www.glassdoor.sg+1
Training & Learning Curve: Good initial training for newcomers entering the recruitment and talent acquisition industry.Jobstore
Flexibility / Hybrid Work: Many reviews note decent hybrid work arrangements and flexible culture depending on the team.Jobstore
Punctual Pay & Benefits: For contractors and internal staff alike, payroll, statutory contributions, and medical benefits are reliably and punctually managed.Indeed+1
Key Cons (Common Criticisms)
High Sales Targets & Pressure: As a commercial recruitment agency, internal consultants face intense KPI/target pressures, leading to long hours during busy cycles.Jobstore
Heavy Administrative Overhead: Staff frequently cite a large volume of internal paperwork, compliance/system updates, and data entry that takes away from core client-facing or business development work.Jobstore
Unclear Career Progression & Leadership Gaps: Lower scores on Glassdoor for senior management (2.7/5) and career opportunities (2.5/5) point to a perceived disconnect between upper leadership strategy and day-to-day execution.www.glassdoor.sg+1
Inconsistent Communication: Occasional complaints regarding a lack of transparency around strategic shifts or slow communication during interview/recruitment loops (including candidate-facing "ghosting" notes).www.glassdoor.sg+1
You can read full, unfiltered feedback directly on the Randstad Singapore Glassdoor Reviews or check broader sentiment on Randstad Indeed Reviews.Are you looking at an internal role (such as recruitment consultant or HR) with Randstad Singapore, or are you considering an external contract/placement job offered through them?
